observations.statement: DELETE /api/cart/items/mouse answers 200 with itemCount 0: the server state is correct.
observations.source: network.json, the DELETE exchange of the failing attempt

observations.statement: After the removal the header link still reads "Cart (1)" while the cart shows "Your cart is empty".
observations.source: assertions.json step 9 and accessibility.json at the failure

hypotheses.statement: api() does not propagate the cart returned by DELETE requests to the header.
hypotheses.rationale: The DELETE response carries the correct itemCount, but nothing in the request layer hands it to the header after a removal.

intervention.description: In api(), refresh the header badge from the response body of DELETE requests.

hypotheses.statement: renderBadge() shows a stale count because it trusts cart.itemCount instead of counting the items.
hypotheses.rationale: The badge is the element that is wrong, and it is rendered from a precomputed field that could be out of date.

intervention.description: Make renderBadge() count the quantities of cart.items instead of reading cart.itemCount.

hypotheses.statement: The server's removeItem() leaves the removed line in the session cart.
hypotheses.rationale: Removal bugs usually live in the mutation of the collection; if the line stayed, the count would stay at 1.

intervention.description: Rebuild the cart lines without the product instead of splicing by index.
